evidence.title: MEM8: retain exact-source CI receipts and raw evidence
evidence.body:
## Why this evidence update is needed

The previous source had native failures and incomplete terminal evidence. This PR preserves those original results and separately records the new V5 source and module-lock qualification, so a source repair or archive recovery cannot be mistaken for memory benefit or full owner recovery.

## Current checkpoint

[V14 checkpoint at immutable evidence head e9c8d26](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/blob/e9c8d26d159edfb72eb9c2b8f4580478b4b37a2d/qualification/memory-cell-mem8-ci-followup/CHECKPOINT_REPAIR_V14.md)

- V5 source-only gates actually passed on run 43015979473 within the original 600-second budget: 393.996016 seconds. Root verified all 103 full source rows, three complete Git trees, 13 old-name scans, caller coverage across 6,200 Rust files, and all 21 formatter postimages. The exact formatter tree is c77785ecb368c44ea699769001a47402c9f50591.
- Pure source 9bd2f589debdba4a93baa363817c3669cb103721 was published to draft PR #5935 at 12:36:36 UTC with an expected-head lease and independent ref/PR readbacks.
- The exact-source Bazel module-lock operation passed on run 43020939762: one actual just bazel-lock-update, 26.462319 seconds within the original 1,200-second command budget; clean identical source and both lock files before/after. The earlier zero-phase version-probe failure and its narrow stream-separation correction remain fully preserved.
- All full original source/Bazel ZIPs, raw logs, manifests and multipart bytes are attached. Root independently read every remote part and verified all archive members and CRCs. Earlier 189711 blocking, Windows, MEM and Architecture original failures and separate denominators remain intact.
- New full native CI on 9bd2 is being audited separately. Blob/Fence job 130526677869 already failed before checkout with local_control_inventory_unavailable; the exact unavailable runtime observation remains unknown. No retry or policy relaxation was introduced.
- The Windows elevated-delete review retains the original outside-root counterexample and all 22 exact source files. A conditional 167+3 successor plan is static only; current Windows scope remains 167. Its cancellation-cause wording has a separate explicit erratum.
- Source inputs, drivers and primary receipts were recovered after the transient environment reset. Fifteen local-only preparation files were not recovered; the manifest records these gaps. Archive recovery is not full owner/effect cold recovery.

## Open adoption gates

All ten adoption gates remain open. Existing retained-memory evidence is unchanged and does not meet adoption. No new scored actor episodes, real model generation, different-key replay of the original unknown provider admission, or Provider G execution is claimed. Actual owner/runtime/store inputs, exposure/trust evidence, unseen matched outcomes and effect recovery/cost evidence remain required.

This PR stays a draft. No merge or deployment is performed.

owner.body:
## Why this update is needed

Source repairs and archive verification have progressed, while the original owner, provider and scientific adoption gates remain open. This draft checkpoint records the actual source/CI evidence and the concrete missing inputs without converting fixture or archive results into owner recovery or retained-memory benefit.

## Current checkpoint

[Owner BLOCKERS.json v9 at fb53329](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/blob/fb533298874d85b6d6ec3d0d1352cd847e54ac4f/qualification/memory-cell-mem8-owner/run-001/BLOCKERS.json)

- Current source PR #5935 is 9bd2f589debdba4a93baa363817c3669cb103721, tree c77785ecb368c44ea699769001a47402c9f50591, and stays a draft.
- V5 source-only qualification passed in 393.996016 seconds within the original 600-second budget. A separately pinned exact-source Bazel module-lock operation passed in 26.462319 seconds within 1,200 seconds, with clean unchanged source and both lock files byte-identical.
- The full original evidence is published in [V14, e9c8d26](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/blob/e9c8d26d159edfb72eb9c2b8f4580478b4b37a2d/qualification/memory-cell-mem8-ci-followup/CHECKPOINT_REPAIR_V14.md). Root verified complete original archive bytes and manifests. Historical zero-job/version-probe failures and the 15 unrecovered local preparation files are explicit.
- New required/native CI is being audited separately on 9bd2. Its original Blob/Fence job failed before checkout with local_control_inventory_unavailable; the blob checks did not run. This checkpoint does not copy old-head case counts into new-head passes.
- Root compared v9 to exact immutable v7. All nine non-CI gate objects, the original HOSTED-CI closure criterion, every prior closed-scope row, retained-memory results, provider UNKNOWN/physical-count-null state and source exclusions are unchanged.
- The intake table now identifies each gate's actual missing inputs, custodian role, verified existing entrypoint and closure evidence. It does not invent an original owner identity, an authenticated readiness command, an independent trust domain or certified unseen sources.

## Adoption boundary

All ten gates remain open. The two newly closed items are source and module-lock subgates only. No new scored actor outcome, real model request, different-key replay of the unknown provider turn, or Provider G execution is introduced. Existing assertions, budgets, thresholds and exposure/trust requirements remain intact.

[Root review and reproducible comparison](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/tree/fb533298874d85b6d6ec3d0d1352cd847e54ac4f/qualification/memory-cell-mem8-owner/run-001/v9)

This PR stays a draft. No merge or deployment is performed.
